usage: Supporting identity reads for team compositions, not directory-user lifecycle management. Pinned myorganization/first-result behavior remains characterized separately; native fallback uses documented /users and checks uniqueness.

rules.identifier: explicit UUID returns unchanged without validating existence or acquiring credentials
rules.direct: GET /v1.0/users/{id|UPN}?$select=id; leading-$ UPN uses the documented OData key form; all selectors remain escaped
rules.current: GET /v1.0/me?$select=id only when explicitly allowed in delegated context
rules.fallback: only a received direct 404 permits GET /v1.0/users?$filter=mail eq '{escaped literal}'&$select=id&$top=2
rules.uniqueness: follow all pages within the explicit bound; distinct IDs are ambiguous; repeated identical IDs do not establish a second identity; incomplete traversal never establishes absence/uniqueness
rules.pending: 202 remains distinct from a usable completed lookup; metadata and an available snapshot are retained without issuing mutations
rules.writes: no user creation, permission grants, mutations, identity switching or hidden cleanup
